description: Estimate house flip profit and ROI from purchase, rehab, holding and selling costs versus the sale price.

faqs.a: Profit = sale price − (purchase + rehab + holding costs) − selling costs. ROI = profit ÷ total cash in (all costs except the sale).
faqs.q: How is flip profit and ROI calculated?

faqs.a: Mortgage payments, taxes, insurance and utilities during the project. Enter their total for the holding period.
A typical agent commission plus closing costs is 6–8% of the sale price; adjust the percentage to match your deal.
faqs.q: What selling-cost percentage should I use?

howto: Enter purchase price, rehab budget and holding costs.
Enter the expected sale price and selling-cost percentage.
Read your estimated profit and ROI.
